sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><api_name>x_thrive.UnsafeAjaxHelper</api_name><name>UnsafeAjaxHelper</name><client_callable>true</client_callable><active>true</active><script><![CDATA[var UnsafeAjaxHelper = Class.create();
UnsafeAjaxHelper.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    getRecord: function() {
        var table = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');
        var query = this.getParameter('sysparm_query');
        var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        gr.addEncodedQuery(query);
        gr.query();
        var apiKey = "sk_live_ABCDEF1234567890";
        while (gr.next()) {
            var inner = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
            inner.get(gr.getValue('caller_id'));
        }
        gr.deleteMultiple();
        return apiKey;
    },
    type: 'UnsafeAjaxHelper'
});]]></script><sys_id>abc123</sys_id></sys_script_include></record_update>

    async function notify() {
        var res = await fetch('https://example.com');
    }

    current.setWorkflow(false);
    current.update();
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_id>def456</sys_id></sys_script></record_update>
